note: HBL's schedule of bank charges (1 July to 31 December 2026): the monthly service charge of 50 rupees on accounts averaging under 40,000 rupees exempts regular PLS saving accounts and conventional current accounts, so the conventional current account carries no fee for keeping it; per-transaction, cheque book and card charges aren't modelled.

sources.title: HBL, Schedule of Bank Charges (effective July 01, 2026 to December 31, 2026)
sources.said: Effective from July 01, 2026 to December 31, 2026 ... Part L MISCELLANEOUS CHARGES ... Service Charges are to be applied Rs. 50/- Flat (including FED/ST) to be recovered on monthly basis. ... where the monthly average balance is ... less than Rs. 40,000/- on all Current ... and Savings accounts other than ... regular PLS Saving Accounts and ... Conventional Current Accounts ... 10) Conventional Current Accounts
